evidenceLayout: tmp/ed-editor-20260926-s186/<planId>/attempt-<n>/ holds pre-edit-hashes.txt, intent.md, post-edit-hashes.txt, notes.md and final-hashes.txt (tmp is gitignored). Logs go to target/fe-logs/ed-<wave>-<check>-s<S>-<n>.log per design 6.5.7. The per-plan wasm artifact copy is target/ed-wasm/<planId>.wasm.
logRule: Design 6.5.7: every run writes a new log (S = Riela session number; n counts from 1 per check within the session; never overwrite). Every row runs from the repository root with ROOT exported: export ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" (the first row of each array). LOG is the ABSOLUTE path "$ROOT/target/fe-logs/ed-<wave>-<check>-s<S>-<n>.log", and each row runs as (set -o pipefail; (CMD) 2>&1 | tee "$LOG"); echo "exit=$?" >> "$LOG". The inner subshell keeps a 'cd editor && ...' CMD from changing the directory tee resolves the log in. The progress log cites the counting log path and its exit= value, and for nextest, cargo test and vitest the run and passed counts (non-zero). A missing log, a log without exit=, or a truncated log fails the check. 'LOG(<name>): CMD' in the verification arrays means CMD run under this rule with <name> as the log stem. Rows run in array order: wasm32 before wasm32-hostwasm, then the artifact copy, then the editor npm steps with VACTROL_WASM pointing at the copy.

commonContract.editProtocol: vactrol-editor-scaffold.md section 'Common Contract (every ED plan)' / 'Edit Protocol': fresh read and sha256 before each edit, intent snapshot before the first edit of any file the plan did not create and of every handed-off file, post-edit hash, stop and re-apply on drift, never edit files outside writePaths/sharedPaths, rustfmt on owned .rs files only, no crate-wide cargo fmt, no git reset/clean/stash/checkout, no branches or worktrees, no commits, Rust through the rust-coding agent followed by check-and-test-after-modify, final-hashes.txt at the end.
commonContract.ownershipRule: Design 15.1.3/15.1.12 and 14.5.3: one writer per file per wave. Sequential handoffs only: each editor/src/<area>/mount.ts stub (ED-SCAFFOLD -> area owner: code ED-CODE, midi ED-MIDI, visual ED-VISUAL, bind ED-BIND, params ED-PARAMS, pkg ED-PKG) and editor/src/app/main.ts, editor/src/app/layout.ts (ED-SCAFFOLD -> ED-FINAL); the ED plan files themselves (each plan -> ED-FINAL for the status line and closing note). Both plans list every handed-off file. editor/package.json and editor/package-lock.json are owned by ED-SCAFFOLD only; no later plan adds an npm dependency. editor/src/app/apis.ts (cross-plan API contracts) and editor/src/protocol/types.ts are written only by ED-SCAFFOLD. Rust files are owned only by ED-WIRE (session, directives attach, sched render, pkg driver/mem_cache, ns/insts iterator) and ED-WASM (host/wasm session half). No two plans of one wave share a file. writePaths list regular files only.
commonContract.gateContract: The step6-implement output payload carries planId, changedFiles is an ARRAY of path strings, and verificationGaps is EMPTY when every automated command passed (manual checks go under residualRisks; a Tauri check BLOCKED under E1 is a verification gap, never empty). Test-integrity and adversarial-review outputs carry NO planId; the adversarial-review output always carries a findings array (empty when none) whose items use only findingId, severity, category, file, line, message, evidence. The integration-review output is the envelope {"when": {needs_revision, redispatch_required, repair_in_place, plans_remaining}, "payload": {needs_revision, loopGate, acceptedPlanIds, findings, recoveryDiagnostic, ...}} with payload an OBJECT, and acceptedPlanIds lists only plans present in plans[] of this manifest.
commonContract.parallelSafety: Plans of one wave run in the same working directory with pairwise-disjoint writePaths and no sharedPaths. An editor-wide (tsc, vitest) or crate-wide check failing only because of a sibling in-flight file is recorded as sibling-caused in the progress log, never fixed by the observer; the join (later waves and ED-FINAL) re-verifies. Shared build outputs are isolated or serialized, never assumed safe because source ownership is disjoint: (1) WASM ARTIFACT: each plan copies the host-wasm artifact to $ROOT/target/ed-wasm/<planId>.wasm right after its own wasm32-hostwasm build and runs the npm steps against that copy, so a sibling default-feature wasm32 build cannot swap the artifact mid-run. (2) editor/node_modules: `npm ci` (which deletes and reinstalls node_modules) runs ONLY in ED-SCAFFOLD (wave 1, alone, after its npm install) and ED-FINAL (serial). Every other plan replaces it with the read-only `cd editor && npm ls --depth=0`, which must exit 0 to show the installed tree matches the ED-SCAFFOLD lockfile. No other plan runs npm ci, npm install or npm update, or deletes or modifies node_modules. A missing or mismatched node_modules is a dependency blocker for the operator, not something a worker repairs. (3) editor/dist: every plan except ED-TAURI and ED-FINAL builds with `npm run build -- --outDir $ROOT/target/ed-dist/<planId> --emptyOutDir` and checks its evidence in that directory. ED-TAURI (the only wave-4 writer of editor/dist, which tauri generate_context! embeds) and ED-FINAL (serial) keep the default editor/dist. The whole-tree gate of issue #5 (npm ci && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build in editor/) is run by ED-FINAL.
commonContract.commitPolicy: The source tree stays uncommitted until the workflow commit step. The plan/design checkpoint commit (before fanout) stages by explicit path only: design-docs/specs/design-implementation.md, design-docs/specs/command.md, design-docs/user-qa/pending-editor-questions.md, design-docs/user-qa/README.md, impl-plans/active/vactrol-editor-*.md, impl-plans/active/ed-editor-20260926-s186-dispatch.json, impl-plans/README.md. It never stages src/, editor/, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock. The single implementation commit on main uses the six CLAUDE.md sections on separate lines and no AI attribution or Co-Authored-By line; its staging list is recorded by ED-FINAL. ED-FINAL never edits this manifest. node_modules/, dist/, editor/src-tauri/target/ and tmp/ are never staged.
commonContract.normativeDesign: design-implementation.md 15.1 (with 9, 11.7, 12.5, 13, 13.5, 14.4, 14.5, 16, 17) and command.md are normative. Where a plan and the design differ, the design wins and the difference goes in that plan's progress log. The vite build checks the session_init export only when VACTROL_REQUIRE_SESSION_ABI=1 (set by ED-WASM and ED-FINAL), because the export lands in wave 3 while earlier plans must build. Design 15.1.3 was amended to state this (step-4 rerun, session 186), and the real-wasm tests never skip.
commonContract.commonVerification: Every plan runs the common rows of vactrol-editor-scaffold.md: ROOT export and log dirs, build, clippy, nextest, plain cargo test, fmt --check, wasm32, wasm32-hostwasm, artifact copy, .rs line count, node/npm versions. Then E1: npm ci in ED-SCAFFOLD and ED-FINAL only, npm ls --depth=0 elsewhere. Then npm run check and npm run test. Then npm run build: to $ROOT/target/ed-dist/<planId> except for ED-TAURI and ED-FINAL, which build to editor/dist. Then the build-output existence check and the .ts line count. Rust-touching plans (ED-WIRE, ED-WASM, ED-FINAL) add build-lsp, clippy-lsp and the wasm32 dependency trees.

issueReference.title: Implement the editor: browser + Tauri, visual feedback, controller binding (TASK-010)

reviewContext.userProblem: TASK-001..009 deliver the language, runtime, audio hosts and the session layer, but there is no editor: editor/ holds only the TASK-008 worklet glue and dev harness, and the browser wasm main half wraps Evaluator+Runtime rather than Session, so no Session Protocol v1 path exists in the browser (issue #5).
requiredOutcomes: Every TASK-010 completion criterion in impl-plans/active/vactrol-core.md checked with evidence; hearing worklet audio, the real-browser visual pane and the Tauri app run recorded as pending user confirmation with automated proxies.

Vitest suites (mock clock, recording transport, real wasm) pass for the protocol client, highlighting/edit reconciliation, slider panel and binding round trip, parameter-editor write-back, display-only grid/roll structural assertions, directive round trip, mode-scoped saving, multi-site BindingKey independence, reactive display batches, sampler waveform editor and visual pane.
npm ci, npm run check, npm run test and npm run build exit 0 in editor/; cargo check of editor/src-tauri exits 0 (or BLOCKED under E1, reported as a gap).
Rust build, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check, nextest, cargo test and both wasm32 builds exit 0.
Per-wave plans marked Completed and impl-plans/README.md updated; a single commit on main with the six-section message and no attribution lines.
supportedEdgeCases: Debounce-race writes: doc-changed flushed before any write; stale-binding reasons handled (vactrol-editor-bind.md).
UTF-8 vs UTF-16 offsets with non-ASCII text (vactrol-editor-scaffold.md, vactrol-editor-code.md).
Provisional or rolled-back values never rendered; one repaint per bindings batch (vactrol-editor-bind.md reactive.test.ts).
Write-back declines on text drift; directive-edit applied only after expected-text verification (vactrol-editor-bind.md).
A shader compile failure keeps the previous program; hush clears to black (vactrol-editor-visual.md).
Malicious or tampered package bodies rejected by the Rust pipeline and OPFS entries deleted (vactrol-editor-pkg.md, vactrol-editor-wire.md driver tests).
No WebMIDI (Tauri) and no WebGL2 report not available; MIDI access only on a user action (vactrol-editor-midi.md, vactrol-editor-visual.md).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Browser self-analysis taps, browser MIDI out and raw-frame oscilloscope taps (E2).
Native-tier visuals, use-fps/use-canvas, live gain-reduction metering, Tauri MIDI fallback.
Automated audible or real-browser visual confirmation; cargo tauri build.
constraints: Implement exactly the TASK-010 deliverables and criteria as pinned by design-implementation.md 15.1.
Rust changes limited to the additive gaps G1-G6; v stays 1; main_half.rs, worklet_half.rs, processor.js and the dev harness unchanged.
Network access limited to the public npm registry; crates.io for the Tauri shell only under E1.
Cargo runs with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; one complete log per command with exit= recorded; every plan runs plain cargo test, nextest and npm run test.
designDecisionsAndRationale: One frontend speaks Session Protocol v1 over two transports, the wasm session half and the native WebSocket (15.1.1, 15.1.4).
One site-write path for slider, drag, CC and parameter-editor handles (15.1.6, 15.1.7).
The grid and roll are displays with no write-back path, asserted structurally (15.1.7).
Meters and scopes render from published analyzer cells, not browser taps (15.1.2 G4, E2).
ExternalFile persistence kept editor-side in the 14.5.8 format (E4).
The Tauri shell is a standalone crate with dialog-scoped fs only (15.1.11).
intentionalTradeoffs: Waves: SCAFFOLD -> {WIRE, CODE, MIDI} -> {WASM, BIND, VISUAL} -> {PARAMS, PKG, TAURI} -> FINAL; ED-WIRE depends on ED-SCAFFOLD only for its npm verification rows.
The build-time session_init export check is gated by VACTROL_REQUIRE_SESSION_ABI=1 (ED-WASM, ED-FINAL).
Plan files are archived in a separate docs commit after the workflow commit, as in issues #3 and #4.
nonGoals: UI framework, Lezer grammar, native-tier visuals, browser taps, MIDI out, per-slot levels, add-to-panel UI, Swift.
decisionsNotToReopen: Editor Requirements (slider panel with two modes, DAW-style editors, display-only grid/roll, #@ directives as the default), the visual model (WebGL2 ping-pong), the self-analysis model, host tiers (browser first, Tauri wraps the same frontend, no Swift), and the language decisions of issues #1-#4.
openUserQa: E1 crates.io access for the Tauri shell cargo check (blocks that gate only).
E2 browser taps and MIDI out deferred; meters from analyzer cells.
E3 per-slot activity instead of per-slot levels; mute is stop.
E5 node engines >= 20, no mise pin.
